meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. Now who decided, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, when, and under which section of your own procedure, because a first concern goes nowhere near his record. It comes off today. If it doesn't, I'm in the principal's office before I leave this building, and then the board.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
"Just a note." Then take it out of his file today, in writing. Who put it there?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the note removed from Owen's student file, the zero withdrawn, and a written answer on who decided and whether Owen was heard before the mark was entered. I expect the note out of his file today, as I said in the meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the note out of his file, the zero withdrawn and an answer on who decided; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: owning the missed call to her in one sentence earned a small flat sign of ground, because owning the process without excuses is the one thing she respects.
What cost ground: telling her the concern was already in his file and then brushing it off as meaningless, because his record is the one thing she will never trade and it sent her straight back to the principal and the board.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you showed no evidence at all, so nothing came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is only why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked who decided and whether Owen was heard, answer that plainly and show one dated document tied to Owen's own work before anything about his file comes up.
